title: clinopodium serpyllifolium subsp. barbatum
intro: Clinopodium serpyllifolium subsp. barbatum, commonly known as Beard Scented Calamint or Woolly Calamint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent the growth of certain bacteria. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium serpyllifolium subsp. barbatum include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
